entries.text: Ooohohoho! Ooohohoho![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_01

entries.text: So this is the very center of Paldea! What an\nenormous crater![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_02

entries.text: That’s exactly right, dearest O’Nare! This right\nhere is the Great Crater of Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_01

entries.text: It seems we have a new adventure to quench my\nwanderlust, Billy! Come, let’s begin our descent![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_03

entries.text: We mustn’t, dearest O’Nare! Entering the crater\nis strictly forbidden! I petitioned the League for\r\naccess, but to no avail...[VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_02

entries.text: I beg your pardon?! They won’t even let a\nGlitterati enter?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_04

entries.text: They won’t even let a Glitterati enter![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_03

entries.text:
But this was to be the conclusion to our retreat!
And we’ve been as good as gold and better!\c
I never imagined there would be something in
this world off-limits to a Glitterati...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_05

entries.text: Hm...? Why, it’s that commoner who can’t seem\nto get enough of us![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_06

entries.text: You’re right! Your eyes do not deceive you—\nit’s that commoner who can’t get enough of us![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_04

entries.text: Say, dear commoner... Have you entered this\ncrater before, perchance?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_07

entries.text: I have!
entries.label: s1_sub_009_select_01

entries.text: Nope
entries.label: s1_sub_009_select_02

entries.text: Rags to riches! This commoner’s had the fortune\nto enter the crater, but the Glitterati have not?![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_08

entries.text: If neither the common folk nor the Glitterati are\nallowed inside, just who is?! I don’t understand![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_09

entries.text: Well, then. It seems we have no choice but\nto duel.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_10

entries.text: Th-there it is! O’Nare’s favorite pastime—\nchallenging others to a duel like a Thunderbolt\r\nfrom the blue![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_05

entries.text: But this really isn’t the place for a battle. Let’s\nhead back down![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_24

entries.text: Ohoho... Do inform me when you’re ready to\nduel, commoner.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_11

entries.text: This must feel like a Thunderbolt from the blue,\nbut you should battle dearest O’Nare—lightning\r\nnever strikes the same place twice, after all![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_npc

entries.text: One last duel—what do you say?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_12

entries.text:
You know, I think I quite like it when a commoner
tells me no now and then...\c
But the time of a Glitterati is exceedingly
valuable! We will have this battle RIGHT NOW![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_13

entries.text: I, O’Nare—the president of Paldea Realty—will\ncrush you, commoner![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_14

entries.text: [EMPTY 42]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_06

entries.text: You know, I’ve had time to calm down, and I\nthink I finally get it now...[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_15

entries.text: Glitterati, commoners...in the end, we’re all just\npeople. There’s nothing separating us.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_16

entries.text: Why did it take me so long to realize something\nso simple?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_17

entries.text: I’m so embarrassed... I wish I could crawl under\na rock and hide. I couldn’t literally crawl under\r\na rock, of course, but you know what I mean.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_18

entries.text: You were following us around just to teach us\nthat, weren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_19

entries.text: As expected! I’m not sure why I even asked.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_20

entries.text: I can’t express my appreciation enough...\nBut I hope that these fine items can suffice?[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_21

entries.text: You received the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Glitterati Case[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!
entries.label: s1_sub_009_system_02

entries.text: Now then, Billy! I feel as though I’ve grown as a\nperson during this trip.[VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_22

entries.text: Starting tomorrow, I’m turning over a new leaf! I’ll\nresume my work as CEO, holding nothing back![VAR 0x0114(0041)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_woman_23

entries.text: Pfwee! Learning from your failures like a pro!\nYou really are an exemplary Glitterati![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_08

entries.text: Now, since you’ve taught us a little something, I’ll\nteach you a little something![VAR 0x0114(0040)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_man_09

entries.text: You learned the [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]Oh No! emote[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] from Billy!
entries.label: s1_sub_009_system_01

entries.text: Right, then... Adiós![VAR 0x0114(003A)]
entries.label: s1_sub_009_two_01

entries.text: Lady O’Nare and Mr. Billy went to go see the\ncentermost part of Paldea.
entries.label: s1_sub_009_secretary_01

entries.text: I guess that means they’d be making their way to\nthe Great Crater...
entries.label: s1_sub_009_secretary_02

entries.text: I can’t imagine they’d try to climb down, but...\nI’m a little worried. Could you go check on them?
entries.label: s1_sub_009_secretary_03
